VBO:0200384.summary: Coonhounds are scent hounds developed for following raccoons to trees. The group includes distinct breeds such as the Redbone and Bluetick; UKC hunting events test trailing and treeing work separately from conformation shows.
VBO:0200384.shortDescription: Coonhounds include several breeds developed for trailing raccoons and locating them in trees.
